prompt: Build for this brief: A cultural venue; visitors browse works, plan visits and find events. Use Marine and Coral: page #F7FCFF, text #113C50, accent #B73545, secondary surface #E5F3F8, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Archivo and reading text in Inter; grotesque heading with neutral interface text. Composition: Persistent navigation, dense results table, selected-item inspector, restrained headings. Use body 14px, heading 48px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 8px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
